title: Fault family — Presence: an optional field referenced in a value position must be proven set (PRE0116 / UnprovedPresenceRequirement)

citations.note: Fault family row: the obligation is the catalog-declared safety precondition at the evaluation site; premise classes (b)/(c)/(a) per catalog ProofSatisfactions, with (d) admitted under the 2026-07-21 citation duty
Fault minting + site identity (2026-07-21): each evaluation OCCASION mints its own presence obligation, one per route
2026-07-21 citation-duty ruling extends declared-fact premises to the fault family; and the written-value (E2) provenance ruling
Ratification gate: no cell ratifies whose derivation cites an argument-less rule; the seven named validity arguments

AddPresenceObligation — presence is ENGINE-SYNTHESIZED, not catalog-declared: constructed directly in WalkExpression (:293 TypedFieldRef, :301 TypedArgRef under includeOptionalArgRefs). No operator/function/action ProofRequirements slot mints it; a catalog-only enumeration silently drops this kind
PresenceProofRequirement(SelfSubject with null Accessor, Description) — the subject is the field itself

The only built presence discharge: a GuardInPath guard conjunct whose field matches the subject and whose IsPresenceCheck is true (the `is set` guard). ReassignedBefore kills a stale presence guard (sequential proof flow)
UnprovedPresenceRequirement = 116 (PRE0116) — the rejection diagnostic every base in this file carries

citations.ref: docs/Working/transport-rule-restatement-2026-07-21.md § Where a site is evaluated — the route relation
citations.note: The route classes reaching each evaluation-site category this file uses (transition-row-action-operand, state-hook-action-operand, stateless-hook-action-operand, rule-condition, state-ensure-condition, event-ensure-condition, computed-field-expression, quantifier-predicate)
Respellable: the band member is a sound alternate spelling of the `is set` guard; for guard-bearing sites it respells into `when F is set`

notes: The presence discharge is binary (a field is set or it is not), so the sound-but-unprovable band is narrow: it is the sound alternate SPELLINGS of the presence guard that the built matcher does not recognize — e.g. the double-negated `when not (F is not set)`, and the inline short-circuit forms `F is not set or <reads F>` and `if F is set then <reads F> else <fallback>`, both live-verified to still reject (see the state-ensure/computed-field cells).

For a GUARD-bearing evaluation site (transition row, state hook, stateless hook, rule/quantifier-rule condition) every such band member has a licensed respelling: move the presence into the site's own `when F is set` activation guard. Verdict yes there.

For a NO-GUARD evaluation site (ensure condition, computed-field expression) the same sound inline forms have NO licensed respelling — an ensure/computed field cannot carry `when` (live-verified PRE0009 parse error), so there is no surface to move the presence into. Those cells are recorded as OPEN (the discharge itself is undefined), so the respellability question there is subsumed by the open disposition rather than a band verdict. If those cells are later ruled discharge-defined, this family verdict must be re-measured against the corpus, since a no-guard sound form with no respelling would flip the verdict to no (a surface decision routed to the owner).
Model-derived only. Per the ratification protocol the family verdict ratifies only when it agrees with the classified sample corpus, which has not been run for this family.

metavariables.name: Score
metavariables.standsFor: the optional primitive field referenced in a value position at the transition-row action RHS

normalization.note: the Normalization bullet — presence is a nullary predicate; the guard conjunct `Score is set` matches the obligation `Score is set` identically, no numeric normalization applies

cells.premiseAvailability: The only applicable premise class is (c), the handler's guard. The obligation mints solely for a DeclaredPresenceMeta.Optional field (ProofEngine.cs:290-293); a `when Score is set` guard on the row establishes presence for the action that follows, since the row's action runs only if the guard evaluated true (spec:1897) and evaluation is pure and deterministic (spec:170, :96). Premise (a) — a field modifier — is structurally inapplicable: there is no value modifier that keeps a field optional while proving it present, and a field declared with guaranteed presence never mints this obligation at all (the mint is gated on Optional). Premise (b) is inapplicable: the subject is a field, not an event arg. Premise (d) — a pre-state constraint establishing `Score is set` (e.g. a residency ensure `in S ensure Score is set`) — is admitted for the fault family under the 2026-07-21 citation duty, but the matrix's § Rule validity states NO validity argument for a rule/constraint-premised (CompositionalConstraint) discharge of a fault obligation; the same gap fault-1 records for numeric premise (d). Recorded as a missing rule, not resolved here. Written-value provenance (E2) would also apply in principle (a prior `set Score = <present>` in the same plan), but it is design-parked, unbuilt for presence (live-verified: `set Score = <arg> ; read Score` still emits PRE0116), and has no entry in the seven-member validity-argument enum.

dischargeContract.decisionProcedure: Search the in-path guard conjuncts (a finite set) for one whose field equals the subject and whose IsPresenceCheck is true, and which is not in ReassignedBefore. No such conjunct rejects.

suggestions.schema: add a guard `when <field> is set` on the row that reaches this read

citations.note: the suggestion-schema bullet — stated per applicable premise class

base.program:
precept PresenceTransition

field Score as integer optional
field Recorded as integer default 0

state Active initial

event Create() initial
event SetScore(Value as integer)
event Record()

on Create
    -> set Recorded = 0

from Active on SetScore
    -> set Score = SetScore.Value
    -> no transition

from Active on Record
    -> set Recorded = Score
    -> no transition

discharges.derivation: guard conjunct `Score is set` matches the subject field -> presence guard-in-path

nearMisses.whyStillRejects: The guard on the WRONG condition: the row fires only when Score is ABSENT, then reads Score — so the read is provably unsafe. The compiler must still reject the same presence obligation.

notes: Band member `if Score is set then Score else 0` / `when not (Score is not set)` respells to `when Score is set` (family verdict yes).

notes: Live-verified at HEAD c295d7b4 via precept_compile (MCP; the MCP serves its last-spawn build, so the exact built commit is unverified — treated as a SYNTAX/compile oracle only, never as authority for what the definition says). Base: 1 diagnostic, PRE0116 on Score, only. Discharge `when Score is set`: 0 diagnostics, Presence disposition Proved, strategy GuardInPath. Near-miss `when Score is not set`: 1 diagnostic, PRE0116 (same obligation).

The discharge cites the validity argument 'Guard normal-form match', whose written form in the matrix is numeric (WP shape `<RHS> <cmp> <bound>`). Its guard-selection core (the guard evaluated true; the action sees the same pre-state; purity + determinism) is what actually licenses the presence discharge, and the match of `Score is set` against `Score is set` is trivial. The matrix carries NO validity argument specialized to the presence predicate; this adequacy gap is flagged for the owner (openFlag).

metavariables.name: Score
metavariables.standsFor: the optional primitive field referenced in a value position inside an `in S ensure` condition

citations.note: the 2026-07-21 citation duty admits (d) for the fault family but supplies no validity argument for it

notes: The obligation MINTS and rejects (live-verified at HEAD c295d7b4): `in Open ensure Score >= Threshold because "..."` over an optional `Score` emits PRE0116 ('used while evaluating ensure for Open'). Base program: `precept EnsurePrimitive` with `field Score as integer optional`, `field Threshold as integer default 10`, `state Open initial`, `on Create -> set Threshold = 10`, `from Open on SetScore -> set Score = SetScore.V -> no transition`, `in Open ensure Score >= Threshold because "..."`. 1 diagnostic, PRE0116, only.

NO discharge is derivable, and this is why the cell is OPEN rather than defined: (i) an ensure cannot carry a `when` guard — `in Open ensure Score >= Threshold when Score is set` is a live-verified PRE0009 PARSE error ('Expected because here, but found when'); (ii) the inline short-circuit forms `Score is not set or Score >= Threshold` and `if Score is set then Score >= Threshold else true` are live-verified to STILL emit PRE0116 (the built engine does not treat a disjunctive/conditional presence test as discharging the value read); (iii) an entering-row guard `from Draft on Activate when Score is set -> transition Open` does NOT discharge the in-Open ensure (live-verified: still PRE0116), because the residency ensure re-evaluates on every in-residence route, not only at entry.

So the only ways to make it compile are to make Score required (which UNMINTS the obligation rather than discharging it) or to establish `Score is set` as a pre-state fact (premise d) / by written-value provenance (E2) — and neither has a named validity argument in the matrix's § Rule validity. The diagnostic's own suggestion ('guard with when Score is set') names a construct the ensure cannot syntactically carry. This is routed to the owner as a missing rule (openFlag), not resolved here.
The diagnostic suggestion text is itself a finding: PRE0116 suggests `when F is set` even at evaluation sites (ensure/computed) where no `when` is grammatically available.

metavariables.name: Deadline
metavariables.standsFor: the optional temporal (pre-state) field referenced in a value position inside an `on E ensure` condition

citations.note: the 2026-07-21 citation duty admits (d) for the fault family but supplies no validity argument for it

notes: The obligation MINTS and rejects (live-verified at HEAD c295d7b4): `on Close ensure Close.At >= Deadline because "..."` over an optional field `Deadline` emits PRE0116 ('used while evaluating ensure for Close'). Base program: `precept EventEnsureTemporal` with `field Deadline as instant optional`, `field Note as string default ""`, `state Open initial`, events `Create()/SetDeadline(D as instant)/Close(At as instant)`, `from Open on SetDeadline -> set Deadline = SetDeadline.D -> no transition`, `from Open on Close -> set Note = "closed" -> no transition`, `on Close ensure Close.At >= Deadline because "..."`. 1 diagnostic, PRE0116, only.

NO discharge is derivable: (i) an event ensure cannot carry `when` — `on Close ensure ... when Deadline is set` is a live-verified PRE0009 parse error; (ii) the inline `Deadline is not set or Close.At >= Deadline` short-circuit is live-verified to still emit PRE0116; (iii) unlike the `in S ensure` cell there is not even an entering-row to carry a guard — the event ensure is an ingress check with no row/hook of its own, and its matrix case shape supplies a discharge only for obligations on the event's ARGS, not on a pre-state field. The subject here is a pre-state field, so the ingress-over-args discharge does not reach it.

The candidate premise is (d) — a residency ensure / rule establishing `Deadline is set` before Close can fire — but fault-(d) has no named validity argument (the same gap fault-1 records). Making Deadline required unmints rather than discharges. Routed to the owner as a missing rule (openFlag).

metavariables.name: Budget
metavariables.standsFor: the optional business-domain input field (here `money in 'USD'`) referenced in a value position inside a `<-` computed-field expression

citations.note: the 2026-07-21 citation duty admits (d) for the fault family but supplies no validity argument for it; the written-value (E2) provenance ruling likewise carries no validity-argument enum entry

notes: The obligation MINTS and rejects (live-verified at HEAD c295d7b4): `field Total as money in 'USD' <- Budget + Fee` with `Budget` optional emits PRE0116 ('used in the computed expression for field Total'). Base program: `precept ComputedBusiness` with `field Budget as money in 'USD' optional`, `field Fee as money in 'USD' default '0.00 USD'`, `field Total as money in 'USD' <- Budget + Fee`, `state Active initial`, `from Active on Allocate -> set Budget = Allocate.Amount -> no transition`. 1 diagnostic PRE0116, only (the currency QualifierCompatibility obligation proves).

NO discharge is derivable: a computed field cannot carry a `when` guard, and the inline conditional `<- if Budget is set then Budget + Fee else Fee` is live-verified to STILL emit PRE0116 (the built engine does not narrow presence through the then-branch of a computed conditional). The computed field recomputes on every operation (including restore), so proving `Budget is set` at recompute would require Budget present in every reachable configuration — i.e. Budget required (which unmints) or a pre-state establishment fact (premise d) / written-value provenance (E2), neither of which has a named validity argument. Routed to the owner as a missing rule (openFlag).

This cell and the two ensure cells share one root gap: at every evaluation site that carries no `when` guard construct (ensure condition, computed-field expression), the only built presence discharge (guard-in-path) is unavailable and no other premise class has a validity argument. That is the single missing rule the owner is asked to author.
